# Git
> Official home for the Git distributed version control system, with documentation, learning resources, tools, downloads, and community links.

Git is a fast, open-source distributed version control system. Git-scm.com is the primary hub for learning Git, installing it, browsing command reference documentation, discovering ecosystem tools, and finding community resources.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://git-scm.com/): Main entry point for Git documentation, downloads, learning resources, and ecosystem navigation.
- [About](https://git-scm.com/about): Overview of Git’s design goals, performance characteristics, and surrounding ecosystem.
- [Learn](https://git-scm.com/learn): Central learning hub with the Pro Git book, videos, tutorials, and cheat sheets.
- [Reference](https://git-scm.com/docs): Git command and documentation reference for everyday and advanced usage.
- [Tools](https://git-scm.com/tools): Directory of Git-related command-line tools, GUIs, IDE integrations, and hosting services.
- [Install](https://git-scm.com/install): Installation options and binary releases for major operating systems.

## Learning Resources
- [Learn Git](https://git-scm.com/learn): Overview page linking to books, tutorials, videos, and quick-reference materials.
- [Pro Git Book](https://git-scm.com/book): Full online Pro Git book covering concepts, workflows, internals, and administration.
- [Videos](https://git-scm.com/videos): Video tutorials and talks for learning Git concepts and practical workflows.
- [External Links](https://git-scm.com/doc/ext): Curated external tutorials, articles, and supplementary Git learning resources.
- [Cheat Sheet](https://git-scm.com/doc): Downloadable and browsable quick-reference materials for common Git commands.

## Documentation & Reference
- [Reference Home](https://git-scm.com/docs): Index of Git manual pages, guides, and release-specific documentation.
- [git(1)](https://git-scm.com/docs/git): Top-level Git manual describing command structure, options, and common usage.
- [Everyday Git](https://git-scm.com/docs/everyday): Practical set of common workflows and commands for daily Git use.
- [gittutorial(7)](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial): Introductory tutorial for basic repository creation, commits, and history inspection.
- [gittutorial-2(7)](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial-2): Intermediate tutorial covering branching, merging, and distributed collaboration.
- [gitglossary(7)](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitglossary): Definitions of Git terminology used throughout the documentation.
- [gitfaq(7)](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitfaq): Frequently asked questions about behavior, workflows, and common Git issues.
- [Documentation Index](https://git-scm.com/docs/git#_git_commands): Structured list of porcelain, plumbing, and ancillary Git commands.

## Essential Command Manuals
- [git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone): Create a local copy of an existing repository from local or remote sources.
- [git-init](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-init): Create an empty Git repository or reinitialize an existing one.
- [git-add](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-add): Add file contents to the index in preparation for committing.
- [git-commit](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-commit): Record staged changes to repository history with metadata and messages.
- [git-status](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status): Show working tree state, staged changes, and branch information.
- [git-log](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log): Inspect commit history with filtering, formatting, and revision traversal options.
- [git-diff](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-diff): Compare working tree, index, commits, branches, and other revisions.
- [git-restore](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-restore): Restore working tree files or staged content from commits or the index.

## Branching, Merging, and Collaboration
- [git-branch](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-branch): List, create, rename, and delete branches.
- [git-switch](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-switch): Switch branches or create and move to a new branch.
- [git-merge](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-merge): Join development histories and resolve merge results.
- [git-rebase](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rebase): Reapply commits onto a new base for cleaner history.
- [git-cherry-pick](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-cherry-pick): Apply selected commits from one branch onto another.
- [git-fetch](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fetch): Download objects and refs from another repository without merging.
- [git-pull](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-pull): Fetch from a remote and integrate changes into the current branch.
- [git-push](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push): Update remote refs with local commits and branch changes.

## Advanced Reference
- [git-config](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config): Read and write repository, global, and system configuration values.
- [git-remote](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-remote): Manage tracked remote repositories and their URLs.
- [git-submodule](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-submodule): Initialize, update, and manage repositories embedded within another repository.
- [git-worktree](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-worktree): Manage multiple working trees attached to a single repository.
- [git-stash](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-stash): Temporarily save and restore uncommitted working directory changes.
- [git-reflog](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-reflog): Inspect updates to refs for recovery and history troubleshooting.
- [git-reset](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-reset): Move branch tips and adjust index or working tree state.
- [git-rev-parse](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rev-parse): Parse revision identifiers and repository-related command-line parameters.

## Tools & Ecosystem
- [Tools Home](https://git-scm.com/tools): Overview of Git ecosystem tools across interfaces and platforms.
- [Command Line Tools](https://git-scm.com/tools/command-line): Third-party terminal-based tools that enhance Git workflows.
- [GUIs](https://git-scm.com/tools/guis): Desktop graphical clients for working with Git repositories.
- [Hosting](https://git-scm.com/tools/hosting): Repository hosting and collaboration platforms built around Git.
- [Text Editors & IDEs](https://git-scm.com/tools/text): Editors and IDEs with Git integration and repository support.
- [Issue Trackers](https://git-scm.com/tools/issue-tracking): Project and issue tracking tools commonly used alongside Git.
- [Submodules & Extensions](https://git-scm.com/tools/submodules): Related tools and extensions for specialized repository workflows.

## Installation
- [Install Git](https://git-scm.com/install): Installation overview with links to platform-specific packages and binaries.
- [Downloads](https://git-scm.com/downloads): Download page for source code and platform-specific installers.
- [Download for Windows](https://git-scm.com/download/win): Windows installer and related setup guidance.
- [Download for macOS](https://git-scm.com/download/mac): macOS installation options including installers and package managers.
- [Download for Linux/Unix](https://git-scm.com/download/linux): Linux and Unix installation instructions using distribution package managers.
- [Download Source](https://git-scm.com/downloads/source): Source tarballs for building Git from source.

## Community & Project Information

- [Mailing List](https://git-scm.com/community): Primary collaboration and discussion venue for Git development and support.
- [Submit a Bug Report](https://git-scm.com/community): Guidance for reporting issues and contributing fixes to Git.
- [About this Site](https://git-scm.com/site): Information about git-scm.com, its maintenance, licensing, and contributors.
- [Software Freedom Conservancy](https://git-scm.com/sfc): Donation and fiscal sponsorship information for the Git project.

## Book & Long-Form Guides
- [Pro Git Book Home](https://git-scm.com/book): Landing page for the complete Pro Git book in multiple formats.
- [Getting Started](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Getting-Started-About-Version-Control): Introductory book chapter explaining version control and Git basics.
- [Git Basics](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Basics-Getting-a-Git-Repository): Core workflows for repositories, staging, committing, and remotes.
- [Branching and Merging](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Branching-Branches-in-a-Nutshell): Conceptual and practical guide to Git branching workflows.
- [Distributed Git](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Distributed-Git-Distributed-Workflows): Collaboration models and distributed development practices with Git.
- [Git Internals](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Plumbing-and-Porcelain): Detailed explanation of Git object model, references, and low-level mechanics.
